portal_description:
NetworkManager is a system network service that manages network devices and connections, attempting to keep active network connectivity when available. Its capabilities include managing Ethernet, wireless, mobile broadband (WWAN), and PPPoE devices, as well as providing VPN integration with a variety of different VPN services.

This update fixes the following bug:

* Previously, NetworkManager in some cases failed to initialize the Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) of a VLAN device to match the MTU of the parent interface. The bug has been fixed, and now the MTU is inherited properly. (BZ#1439166)

Users of NetworkManager are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix this bug.
